node.title: Checking @INC for available modules without side-effects?
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
Hi

Is it possible to check if a module is available for [DOC://use|use] in @INC, BUT without side effects?

I mean eval { "require MODULE" } will at least compile MODULE.pm and execute any [DOC://perlmod|BEGIN] block inside at compile time.

Background: I have a project where I allow to dynamically add freely named modules via INC-hooks*, it would be nice to know beforehand if there are potential conflicts with already available modules.

TIA!

Cheers Rolf
(addicted to the Perl Programming Language :)
